newsitem.title: USA: Meadowbrook Insurance in underwriting pact.
newsitem.headline: Meadowbrook Insurance in underwriting pact.

text.p: Meadowbrook Insurance Group Inc said Tuesday it had agreed to a five-year joint underwriting agreement with Connecticut Surety Corp.
Under the agreement, which takes effect January 1, Meadowbrook's insurance subsidiary, Star Insurance Co, will issue policies in states where Connecticut Surety is not licensed.
Meadowbrook said it will earn a ceding commission and transfer the risk to Connecticut Surety.
Meadowbrook said the transaction should not have a material effect on 1996 earnings.
Meadowbrook's surety operations in Southfield, Reno, San Jose and Las Vegas will become underwriting, claims, and production offices of Connecticut Surety.
Meadowbrook will maintain a Southfield surety operation to participate in the joint underwriting agreement.
Meadowbrook's current surety bond employees will become employees of Connecticut Surety, the company said.
Connecticut Surety also agreed to assume the unearned premium and the associated underwriting risks on the bulk of the existing surety business, Meadowbrook said.

"Connecticut Surety Corp approached us with the idea of a joint underwriting agreement and premium transfer, because of their desire to find a partner to help them grow their core business," Merton Segal, Meadowbrook chairman, said. "This also allows Meadowbrook to earn fee-based revenues with reduced underwriting risk."
